scenes.title: Thought
scenes.summary: Thought belongs to rhetoric: proving, refuting, rousing feelings, magnifying and minimizing, done in speech as the incidents do it without words.

scenes.title: Forms of Utterance
scenes.summary: Command, prayer, statement and threat belong to the art of delivery; Protagoras' charge that "Sing, goddess, the wrath" gives an order is no fault of poetry.
